title: Evidence hierarchy + cheapest-first resolution cascade (backlog E4-S8, ARCHITECTURE §15.6)

tiers.name: Pixels (grounding)
tiers.note: Can veto anything: a tier-0 contradiction removes the candidate.

tiers.name: Independent recognizer readings + visual exemplar similarity
tiers.note: Readings are independent: no engine sees another's answer.

tiers.name: Lexical mapping (verified > observed doctor > generated alias) + terminology validity
Priors (doctor frequency, co-order / sequence, specialty, layout)
tiers.note: Only re-rank candidates already supported by tiers 0-2; never create one, never override a tier-0/1 contradiction.

negative_constraints.note: Only eliminate a candidate, with the rule id; never add one.

levels.name: Reading as recognized (the field needs no concept)
levels.implemented_by: S3 OCR + S4 extraction: the value is the reading itself

levels.name: Exact alias
levels.implemented_by: S5 terminology: the text as written is a concept's display or verified alias

levels.name: Normalized
levels.implemented_by: S5 terminology after normalization (case, punctuation, HbA1c variants, dosage-form words)

levels.name: Qwen contextual adjudication (both candidates + crop, only after independent reads)

validation_basis.assumed: Not measured: the S6 gate's fixed thresholds as they stand. Replaced per field x cohort by held-out adjudicated data (E4-S2 calibration, E4-S3 thresholds, E4-S10 precision-at-coverage).
